"""Exact source-gated C158190 yield-sign Native capture entrypoint."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from carla_yield_operator import make_adapter, validate_scene
from yield_view_measurement import ASSIGNMENT
from yield_scene_construction import VARIANTS, construct, validate_site, verify_original_sources
from native_capture import capture
from native_output_bridge import publish


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def check(site_path=None, site_sha256=None):
    config = json.loads((ROOT / "config.json").read_text())
    if (config.get("assignment_id") != ASSIGNMENT or
            config.get("cell_id") != "C158190" or
            config.get("law_id") != "NRS-484B-257-1" or
            hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "case-plan.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest() != config.get("plan_sha256")):
        raise ValueError("exact yield branch or plan hash differs")
    case_id = config.get("selected_case_id")
    if (case_id not in config.get("supported_case_ids", []) or
            case_id.removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__") not in VARIANTS):
        raise ValueError("unknown selected yield case")
    if site_path is not None or site_sha256 is not None:
        if (site_path is None or site_sha256 is None or
                hashlib.sha256(Path(site_path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != site_sha256):
            raise ValueError("reviewed original yield-site hash required")
        site = validate_site(site_path, case_id)
        verify_original_sources(site, site_path)
        validate_scene(site)
    return {"case_id": case_id, "site_sha256": site_sha256}


def run_attempt(world, adapter, site, site_path, case_id, output_dir, site_hash):
    """Seal output only after Native settings and owned actors are released."""
    built = construct(adapter, site_path, case_id)
    try:
        capture(world, adapter, site, case_id, output_dir, site_hash)
    finally:
        try:
            adapter.destroy(built["through_vehicle_actor_id"])
        finally:
            adapter.destroy(built["yield_sign_actor_id"])
    return publish(output_dir, map_bytes=adapter.map_bytes(world), restored=True)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.check:
        print(check()["case_id"])
        return
    site_name = os.environ.get("SCENARIO_YIELD_SITE_PACKET")
    site_hash = os.environ.get("SCENARIO_YIELD_SITE_SHA256")
    if not all((site_name, site_hash, args.output_dir)):
        raise ValueError("reviewed yield site and Native output required")
    site_path = Path(site_name).resolve()
    selected = check(site_path, site_hash)
    import carla
    client = carla.Client(args.host, args.port)
    client.set_timeout(30.0)
    world = client.get_world()
    site = validate_site(site_path, selected["case_id"])
    adapter = make_adapter(world, site, selected["case_id"])
    run_attempt(world, adapter, site, site_path, selected["case_id"], args.output_dir, site_hash)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Acquire source-bound original yield motion and synchronized four-view video."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

from yield_view_measurement import ASSIGNMENT
from yield_scene_construction import VARIANTS

VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
SIZES = {"overview": (1920, 1080), "approach": (1280, 720),
         "reference_corner": (1280, 720), "driver_reference": (1280, 720)}
FRAMES = 900
RATE = 20
SOURCE_FIELDS = ("map_source_sha256", "ego_route_source_sha256", "yield_sign_survey_sha256",
                 "marking_survey_sha256", "view_ray_survey_sha256",
                 "through_highway_survey_sha256")


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write_json(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                                    allow_nan=False) + "\n")


def _encoder(output, view):
    width, height = SIZES[view]
    return subprocess.Popen(
        ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
         "-f", "rawvideo", "-pixel_format", "rgb24", "-video_size", f"{width}x{height}",
         "-framerate", str(RATE), "-i", "-", "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", "-threads", "1",
         str(output / (view + ".mkv"))], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)


def _validate_row(row, index, native_frame, site, case_id):
    require(isinstance(row, dict) and row.get("frame") == index and
            row.get("native_frame") == native_frame and
            row.get("original_frame") == native_frame and
            type(row.get("time_s")) in (int, float) and
            math.isfinite(row["time_s"]) and abs(row["time_s"] - index / RATE) <= .002,
            "original Native frame/time join differs")
    for name in ("actor_id", "vehicle_blueprint", "position_m", "heading_xy",
                 "body_vertices_m", "ego_speed_mps", "ego_within_intersection",
                 "distance_to_intersection_m", "through_vehicle_ids", "through_vehicles"):
        require(name in row, "original yield motion field missing: " + name)
    require(type(row["actor_id"]) is int and row["actor_id"] > 0 and
            isinstance(row["vehicle_blueprint"], str) and
            row["vehicle_blueprint"].startswith("vehicle."),
            "original motor vehicle identity missing")
    for name, length in (("position_m", 3), ("heading_xy", 2)):
        values = row[name]
        require(isinstance(values, list) and len(values) == length and
                all(type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value) for value in values),
                "original Native geometry differs: " + name)
    require(isinstance(row["body_vertices_m"], list) and len(row["body_vertices_m"]) >= 4 and
            all(isinstance(vertex, list) and len(vertex) == 3 and
                all(type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value) for value in vertex)
                for vertex in row["body_vertices_m"]), "original body geometry missing")
    require(type(row["ego_within_intersection"]) is bool and
            type(row["ego_speed_mps"]) in (int, float) and row["ego_speed_mps"] >= 0 and
            isinstance(row["through_vehicle_ids"], list) and
            isinstance(row["through_vehicles"], list), "original yield/through observation missing")
    require(row.get("case_id") == case_id and
            row.get("control") == "yield_sign" and
            row.get("stop_line_present") is False and
            row.get("near_crosswalk_present") is False,
            "original yield branch intervention differs")
    for key in SOURCE_FIELDS:
        require(row.get(key) == site[key], "original site source changed: " + key)


def capture(world, adapter, site, case_id, output, site_sha256):
    require(site.get("_source_sha256") == site_sha256,
            "reviewed yield site source changed")
    suffix = case_id.removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__")
    require(suffix in VARIANTS, "unknown selected yield case")
    output = Path(output)
    for name in ("context.json", "original-trace.jsonl", "cameras.json", "receipt.json",
                 "reviewed-site.json", "reviewed-sources.json", "comparison-packet.json",
                 *(view + ".mkv" for view in VIEWS)):
        require(not (output / name).exists(), "original attempt output already populated: " + name)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    site_path = Path(site.get("_source_path", ""))
    require(site_path.is_file() and not site_path.is_symlink() and
            hashlib.sha256(site_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == site_sha256,
            "reviewed yield site bytes changed before capture")
    (output / "reviewed-site.json").write_bytes(site_path.read_bytes())
    source_index = {}
    source_root = site_path.resolve().parent
    for key in SOURCE_FIELDS:
        record = site["source_records"][key]
        source = source_root / record["path"]
        require(source.is_file() and not source.is_symlink() and
                hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == record["sha256"] == site[key],
                "reviewed original source changed during capture: " + key)
        target = output / ("reviewed-" + key + ".source")
        target.write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
        source_index[key] = {"path": target.name, "sha256": site[key]}
    write_json(output / "reviewed-sources.json", source_index)
    context = adapter.read_original_context(site, case_id)
    require(isinstance(context, dict) and context.get("case_id") == case_id and
            context.get("assignment_id") == ASSIGNMENT and
            context.get("source_kind") == "original_native_readback" and
            context.get("control") == "yield_sign" and
            context.get("stop_line_present") is False and
            context.get("near_crosswalk_present") is False and
            context.get("sidewalk_derived_crosswalk_present") is False and
            context.get("police_control_active") is False and
            context.get("traffic_signal_control_active") is False,
            "original governed yield/no-line/no-crosswalk readback missing")
    for key in SOURCE_FIELDS:
        require(context.get(key) == site[key], "original source differs: " + key)
    require(context.get("intersection_id") == site["intersection_id"] and
            context.get("ego_route_source_sha256") == site["ego_route_source_sha256"] and
            isinstance(context.get("source_recording_id"), str) and
            bool(context["source_recording_id"]) and
            isinstance(context.get("approach_view_stations"), list) and
            bool(context["approach_view_stations"]),
            "original recording identity and view-ray stations required")
    context["yield_sign_source_sha256"] = site["yield_sign_survey_sha256"]
    context["view_ray_source_sha256"] = site["view_ray_survey_sha256"]
    cameras = json.loads((Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "config.json").read_text())["cameras"]
    context["camera_plan_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(
        cameras, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
    context["site_sha256"] = site_sha256
    context["duration_frames"] = FRAMES
    context["planned_ego_response"], context["planned_through_traffic_phase"] = VARIANTS[suffix]
    context_path = output / "context.json"
    write_json(context_path, context)
    prior = copy.copy(world.get_settings())
    settings = copy.copy(prior)
    settings.synchronous_mode = True
    settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 1 / RATE
    encoders = {}
    trace_path = output / "original-trace.jsonl"
    try:
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        current = world.get_settings()
        require(current.synchronous_mode is True and
                abs(current.fixed_delta_seconds - 1 / RATE) < 1e-9,
                "Native 20 Hz settings readback failed")
        for view in VIEWS:
            encoders[view] = _encoder(output, view)
        start_time = last_frame = None
        with trace_path.open("w") as trace:
            for index in range(FRAMES):
                adapter.control_frame(case_id, index)
                native_frame = world.tick()
                snapshot = world.get_snapshot()
                now = float(snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds)
                require(type(native_frame) is int and snapshot.frame == native_frame and
                        (last_frame is None or native_frame == last_frame + 1),
                        "Native frame identity discontinuity")
                if start_time is None:
                    start_time = now
                require(math.isfinite(now) and abs(now - start_time - index / RATE) <= .005,
                        "Native timestamp discontinuity")
                last_frame = native_frame
                row = adapter.read_original_frame(case_id, index, native_frame)
                _validate_row(row, index, native_frame, site, case_id)
                trace.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                                       allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                for view in VIEWS:
                    pixels = adapter.camera_rgb24(view, native_frame)
                    width, height = SIZES[view]
                    require(type(pixels) is bytes and len(pixels) == width * height * 3,
                            "original synchronized RGB frame missing: " + view)
                    encoders[view].stdin.write(pixels)
        for view, process in encoders.items():
            process.stdin.close()
            error = process.stderr.read()
            require(process.wait(timeout=300) == 0,
                    "original camera encode failed: " + view + ": " + error.decode(errors="replace"))
        streams = {view: {"path": view + ".mkv", "sha256": sha(output / (view + ".mkv")),
                          "fps": RATE, "frame_count": FRAMES} for view in VIEWS}
        camera_manifest = output / "cameras.json"
        write_json(camera_manifest, {"assignment_id": ASSIGNMENT, "case_id": case_id,
                                     "fps": RATE, "frame_count": FRAMES, "streams": streams})
        receipt = output / "receipt.json"
        write_json(receipt, {"assignment_id": ASSIGNMENT, "case_id": case_id,
                             "source_kind": "original_native_capture", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
                             "fps": RATE, "frame_count": FRAMES,
                             "context_sha256": sha(context_path), "trace_sha256": sha(trace_path),
                             "camera_manifest_sha256": sha(camera_manifest),
                             "site_sha256": site_sha256,
                             "reviewed_source_index_sha256": sha(output / "reviewed-sources.json")})
        return {"context": str(context_path), "trace": str(trace_path),
                "camera_manifest": str(camera_manifest), "receipt": str(receipt)}
    finally:
        for process in encoders.values():
            if process.poll() is None:
                if process.stdin and not process.stdin.closed:
                    process.stdin.close()
                process.terminate()
                process.wait(timeout=30)
        world.apply_settings(prior)
        restored = world.get_settings()
        require(restored.synchronous_mode == prior.synchronous_mode and
                restored.fixed_delta_seconds == prior.fixed_delta_seconds,
                "Native settings restoration readback failed")

"""Publish restored yield-site source packets into the pinned Core format."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from native_capture import FRAMES, VIEWS
from yield_view_measurement import ASSIGNMENT


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


def write_jsonl(path, rows):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("x") as stream:
        for row in rows:
            stream.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                                    allow_nan=False) + "\n")


def publish(root: Path, *, map_bytes: bytes, restored: bool) -> dict:
    require(restored is True and type(map_bytes) is bytes and bool(map_bytes),
            "original Native restoration and OpenDRIVE bytes required")
    root = Path(root)
    receipt = json.loads((root / "receipt.json").read_text())
    context_path, original_path, camera_path = (root / name for name in
                                                ("context.json", "original-trace.jsonl", "cameras.json"))
    for key, path in (("context_sha256", context_path), ("trace_sha256", original_path),
                      ("camera_manifest_sha256", camera_path)):
        require(receipt.get(key) == sha(path), "sealed Native packet changed: " + path.name)
    require(receipt.get("site_sha256") == sha(root / "reviewed-site.json") and
            receipt.get("reviewed_source_index_sha256") == sha(root / "reviewed-sources.json"),
            "reviewed original yield sources changed")
    source_index = json.loads((root / "reviewed-sources.json").read_text())
    for key in ("map_source_sha256", "ego_route_source_sha256", "yield_sign_survey_sha256", "marking_survey_sha256",
                "view_ray_survey_sha256", "through_highway_survey_sha256"):
        record = source_index.get(key, {})
        require(record.get("path") == "reviewed-" + key + ".source" and
                record.get("sha256") == sha(root / record["path"]),
                "reviewed yield source byte seal differs: " + key)
    context = json.loads(context_path.read_text())
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in original_path.read_text().splitlines()]
    cameras = json.loads(camera_path.read_text())
    case_id = receipt.get("case_id")
    require(case_id.startswith(ASSIGNMENT + "__") and context.get("case_id") == case_id and
            cameras.get("case_id") == case_id and receipt.get("source_kind") == "original_native_capture",
            "exact original Native case identity mismatch")
    require(len(rows) == FRAMES and receipt.get("frame_count") == FRAMES and
            cameras.get("frame_count") == FRAMES and receipt.get("fps") == 20 and
            cameras.get("fps") == 20,
            "original Native capture duration incomplete")
    streams = cameras.get("streams", {})
    require(set(streams) == set(VIEWS), "four original RGB camera streams missing")
    for view in VIEWS:
        item = streams[view]
        require(item.get("path") == view + ".mkv" and
                item.get("sha256") == sha(root / item["path"]),
                "original camera stream changed: " + view)
    require(context.get("site_sha256") == receipt.get("site_sha256") and
            context.get("map_source_sha256") == hashlib.sha256(map_bytes).hexdigest(),
            "original reviewed site or loaded map changed")
    road = root / "road.xodr"
    require(not road.exists(), "original OpenDRIVE output already exists")
    road.write_bytes(map_bytes)
    from traffic_spec_adapter.adapter import write_adapter_graph
    from worker_exchange.native_output import seal_capture
    import networkx as nx
    trace, mapping, evidence, native = [], [], [], []
    last_frame = None
    actor_id = rows[0]["actor_id"]
    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        number = row.get("native_frame")
        require(type(number) is int and (last_frame is None or number == last_frame + 1) and
                row.get("frame") == index and abs(row.get("time_s", -1000) - index / 20) <= .002 and
                row.get("actor_id") == actor_id,
                "original Native frame, time or actor identity discontinuity")
        last_frame = number
        x, y, z = row["position_m"]
        hx, hy = row["heading_xy"]
        heading = math.degrees(math.atan2(hy, hx))
        speed = row["ego_speed_mps"]
        velocity = [speed * hx, speed * hy, 0.0]
        participant = {"actor_id": actor_id, "blueprint": row["vehicle_blueprint"],
                       "blueprint_attributes": {"base_type": "car"},
                       "position_m": [x, y, z], "body_vertices_m": row["body_vertices_m"],
                       "heading_deg": heading, "velocity_mps": velocity, "speed_mps": speed}
        packet = {"frame": number, "time_s": row["time_s"],
                  "participants": [participant],
                  "world_settings": {"no_rendering_mode": False},
                  "rgb_sensors": [{"view": view, "source": "original_native_callback_rgb"}
                                  for view in VIEWS],
                  "yield_observation": {"case_id": case_id,
                      "site_sha256": receipt["site_sha256"],
                      "ego_within_intersection": row["ego_within_intersection"],
                      "through_vehicle_ids": row["through_vehicle_ids"],
                      "nearest_view_stations": context.get("approach_view_stations")}}
        graph = nx.DiGraph()
        graph.graph.update(frame=number, time_s=row["time_s"], observed_evidence=packet)
        graph_name = f"graphs/base/{number:08d}.adapter.json"
        target = root / "capture/native" / graph_name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        write_adapter_graph(graph, target)
        native.append({"frame": number, "simulation_time": row["time_s"],
                       "adapter_graph": graph_name})
        mapping.append({"video_frame": index, "carla_frame": number,
                        "native_frame": number, "time_s": row["time_s"]})
        trace.append({"frame": number, "time_s": row["time_s"],
                      "position": {"x": x, "y": y, "z": z}, "position_m": [x, y, z],
                      "velocity_mps": velocity, "heading_deg": heading,
                      "speed_mps": speed, "control": {}})
        evidence.append({"actor_id": actor_id, "original_frame": number,
                         "replay_frame": number, "recording_time_s": row["time_s"],
                         "replay_simulation_time_s": row["time_s"],
                         "ego": {"body_vertices_m": row["body_vertices_m"],
                                 "position_m": [x, y, z], "heading_deg": heading,
                                 "speed_mps": speed,
                                 "speed_provenance": "original_native_actor_readback"},
                         "original_observations": packet, "world": {"weather": {}}})
    write_jsonl(root / "trace.jsonl", trace)
    write_jsonl(root / "video_frames.jsonl", mapping)
    write_json(root / "comparison-packet.json", {
        "case_id": case_id[len(ASSIGNMENT) + 2:],
        "original_recording_id": sha(root / "receipt.json"),
        "assignment_id": ASSIGNMENT,
        "original_trace_id": sha(root / "original-trace.jsonl"),
        "site": context,
        "frames": rows})
    write_jsonl(root / "capture/evidence.jsonl", evidence)
    write_jsonl(root / "capture/native/frames.jsonl", native)
    (root / "capture/recorder_info.txt").write_text("Original Native yield approach capture\n")
    write_json(root / "capture/manifest.json", {
        "acquisition": "original_live_run", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
        "extraction_confirmed": True, "frames": FRAMES,
        "observation_contract_version": 2,
        "sources": {"road.xodr": sha(road), "trace.jsonl": sha(root / "trace.jsonl")},
        "scope": "original yield sign, no-line/no-crosswalk nearest-view crossing and four RGB callbacks"})
    write_json(root / "acquisition-provenance.json", {
        "provenance_kind": "native", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
        "physical_acceptance_claimed": False})
    return seal_capture(root, frames=FRAMES, restoration={"restored": True}, errors=[],
                        encoder_exit_codes={view: 0 for view in VIEWS},
                        context={"map_sha256": sha(road),
                                 "site_sha256": receipt["site_sha256"],
                                 "physical_acceptance_claimed": False})

"""Source-gated construction calls for the three selected yield variants.

The adapter is the Native scene owner. This module refuses to convert the
frozen stop-sign cell label into evidence of a proper yield-sign site.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from yield_view_measurement import ASSIGNMENT


VARIANTS = {
    "yield_slow_hazard": ("slow", "close"),
    "yield_stop_hazard": ("stop", "close"),
    "yield_slow_no_hazard": ("slow", "clear"),
}


def _digest(value, name):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in value):
        raise ValueError("original source hash required: " + name)


def _finite_nonnegative(value, name):
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value) or value < 0:
        raise ValueError("finite nonnegative reviewed " + name + " required")


def validate_site(path: str | Path, case_id: str) -> dict:
    path = Path(path)
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    site = json.loads(raw)
    if site.get("assignment_id") != ASSIGNMENT or site.get("cell_id") != "C158190":
        raise ValueError("original assignment and cell identity required")
    suffix = case_id.removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__")
    if case_id != ASSIGNMENT + "__" + suffix or suffix not in VARIANTS:
        raise ValueError("unknown selected yield case")
    if site.get("review_status") != "reviewed" or site.get("source_kind") != "original_site_survey":
        raise ValueError("original reviewed Native site survey required")
    if site.get("approved_control_variant") != "yield_sign":
        raise ValueError("reviewed yield control variant required for stop-sign catalog cell")
    if not isinstance(site.get("intersection_id"), str) or not site["intersection_id"]:
        raise ValueError("reviewed exact intersection identity required")
    for name in ("map_source_sha256", "ego_route_source_sha256", "yield_sign_survey_sha256",
                 "marking_survey_sha256", "view_ray_survey_sha256",
                 "through_highway_survey_sha256"):
        _digest(site.get(name), name)
    if site.get("police_control_active") is not False or site.get("traffic_signal_control_active") is not False:
        raise ValueError("officer and signal exclusions require original negative readback")
    if (site.get("stop_line_present") is not False or
            site.get("near_crosswalk_present") is not False or
            site.get("sidewalk_derived_crosswalk_present") is not False):
        raise ValueError("original no-line/no-crosswalk/sidewalk survey required")
    sign = site.get("yield_sign")
    if not isinstance(sign, dict) or not sign.get("blueprint_id") or not sign.get("governed_approach_id"):
        raise ValueError("reviewed proper yield-sign blueprint and approach required")
    if not isinstance(sign.get("transform"), dict) or not all(k in sign["transform"] for k in ("x", "y", "z", "yaw")):
        raise ValueError("reviewed yield-sign transform required")
    for key in ("x", "y", "z", "yaw"):
        value = sign["transform"][key]
        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value):
            raise ValueError("finite reviewed yield-sign transform required")
    if not isinstance(site.get("through_vehicle"), dict) or not site["through_vehicle"].get("route_source_id"):
        raise ValueError("reviewed through-highway vehicle route required")
    plans = site.get("case_plans")
    if not isinstance(plans, dict) or suffix not in plans:
        raise ValueError("reviewed exact-case plan required")
    plan = plans[suffix]
    response, phase = VARIANTS[suffix]
    if plan.get("ego_response") != response or plan.get("through_traffic_phase") != phase:
        raise ValueError("reviewed exact-case intervention differs")
    _finite_nonnegative(plan.get("through_start_delay_s"), "through-vehicle timing")
    site["_source_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    site["_source_path"] = str(path.resolve())
    return site


def verify_original_sources(site: dict, site_path: str | Path) -> None:
    """Read every independent reviewed source byte, not only its digest label."""
    root = Path(site_path).resolve().parent
    records = site.get("source_records")
    keys = ("map_source_sha256", "ego_route_source_sha256", "yield_sign_survey_sha256",
            "marking_survey_sha256", "view_ray_survey_sha256",
            "through_highway_survey_sha256")
    if not isinstance(records, dict) or set(records) != set(keys):
        raise ValueError("independent original yield source records required")
    for key in keys:
        record = records[key]
        if not isinstance(record, dict):
            raise ValueError("original source record missing: " + key)
        name = record.get("path")
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or Path(name).name != name:
            raise ValueError("original source path must be local: " + key)
        target = root / name
        if (not target.is_file() or target.is_symlink() or
                hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != record.get("sha256") or
                record["sha256"] != site[key]):
            raise ValueError("original source bytes differ: " + key)


def construct(adapter, site_path: str | Path, case_id: str) -> dict:
    """Issue Native construction calls and reject contradictory readback."""
    site = validate_site(site_path, case_id)
    suffix = case_id.rsplit("__", 1)[-1]
    before = adapter.read_control(site["yield_sign"]["governed_approach_id"])
    if before == "stop_sign":
        raise ValueError("active stop sign conflicts with selected yield governance")
    owned = []
    try:
        sign_id = adapter.spawn_yield_sign(site["yield_sign"]["blueprint_id"],
                                           site["yield_sign"]["transform"])
        if not sign_id:
            raise ValueError("Native yield-sign spawn failed")
        owned.append(sign_id)
        readback = adapter.read_sign(sign_id)
        if (not isinstance(readback, dict) or readback.get("control") != "yield_sign" or
                readback.get("governed_approach_id") != site["yield_sign"]["governed_approach_id"]):
            raise ValueError("Native yield-sign governance readback failed")
        markings = adapter.survey_markings(site["yield_sign"]["governed_approach_id"])
        if (not isinstance(markings, dict) or
                markings.get("stop_line_present") is not False or
                markings.get("near_crosswalk_present") is not False or
                markings.get("sidewalk_derived_crosswalk_present") is not False):
            raise ValueError("Native marking readback contradicts source survey")
        stations = adapter.survey_view_stations(site["yield_sign"]["governed_approach_id"])
        if not isinstance(stations, list) or not any(
                isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("view_of_through_traffic") is True for s in stations):
            raise ValueError("Native through-highway view readback missing")
        vehicle_id = adapter.spawn_through_vehicle(site["through_vehicle"],
                                                   site["case_plans"][suffix]["through_start_delay_s"])
        if not vehicle_id:
            raise ValueError("Native through-vehicle spawn failed")
        owned.append(vehicle_id)
        return {"case_id": case_id, "site_source_sha256": site["_source_sha256"],
                "yield_sign_actor_id": sign_id, "through_vehicle_actor_id": vehicle_id,
                "planned_response": site["case_plans"][suffix]["ego_response"],
                "planned_through_traffic_phase": site["case_plans"][suffix]["through_traffic_phase"],
                "readback_limit": "Native actor and map readback must be retained with original capture."}
    except Exception:
        destroy = getattr(adapter, "destroy", None)
        if callable(destroy):
            for actor in reversed(owned):
                destroy(actor)
        raise

         "reference_corner": (1280, 720), "driver_reference": (1280, 720)}


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def inspect_video(path, view):
    process = subprocess.run(
        ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
         "-show_entries", "stream=codec_name,width,height,avg_frame_rate,nb_read_frames",
         "-of", "json", str(path)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    streams = json.loads(process.stdout).get("streams", [])
    if len(streams) != 1:
        raise ValueError("one original video stream required: " + view)
    data = streams[0]
    if (data.get("codec_name") != "ffv1" or
            (data.get("width"), data.get("height")) != SIZES[view] or
            data.get("avg_frame_rate") not in ("20/1", "20") or
            data.get("nb_read_frames") != "900"):
        raise ValueError("original camera decode/profile mismatch: " + view)


def finalize(case_id, root):
    root = Path(root)
    context, trace, receipt_path, camera_path, packet_path = (
        root / name for name in ("context.json", "original-trace.jsonl", "receipt.json",
                                 "cameras.json", "comparison-packet.json"))
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
    site = json.loads(context.read_text())
    cameras = json.loads(camera_path.read_text())
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in trace.read_text().splitlines()]
    packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text())
    if (receipt.get("assignment_id") != ASSIGNMENT or receipt.get("case_id") != case_id or
            receipt.get("source_kind") != "original_native_capture" or
            receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not False or
            receipt.get("context_sha256") != sha(context) or
            receipt.get("trace_sha256") != sha(trace) or
            receipt.get("camera_manifest_sha256") != sha(camera_path) or
            cameras.get("assignment_id") != ASSIGNMENT or cameras.get("case_id") != case_id or
            site.get("site_sha256") != receipt.get("site_sha256") or
            packet.get("assignment_id") != ASSIGNMENT or
            packet.get("site") != site or packet.get("frames") != rows):
        raise ValueError("original yield source seal mismatch")
    site_path = root / "reviewed-site.json"
    source_index_path = root / "reviewed-sources.json"
    if (receipt.get("site_sha256") != sha(site_path) or
            receipt.get("reviewed_source_index_sha256") != sha(source_index_path)):
        raise ValueError("reviewed original yield site custody differs")
    reviewed = json.loads(site_path.read_text())
    source_index = json.loads(source_index_path.read_text())
    keys = ("map_source_sha256", "ego_route_source_sha256", "yield_sign_survey_sha256", "marking_survey_sha256",
            "view_ray_survey_sha256", "through_highway_survey_sha256")
    if set(source_index) != set(keys):
        raise ValueError("reviewed original yield source index incomplete")
    for key in keys:
        record = source_index[key]
        if (record.get("path") != "reviewed-" + key + ".source" or
                record.get("sha256") != sha(root / record["path"]) or
                record["sha256"] != reviewed.get(key) or
                record["sha256"] != site.get(key)):
            raise ValueError("reviewed original yield source byte seal differs: " + key)
    if (len(rows) != 900 or receipt.get("frame_count") != 900 or
            receipt.get("fps") != 20 or cameras.get("frame_count") != 900 or
            cameras.get("fps") != 20):
        raise ValueError("full original 45 s, 20 Hz trace required")
    streams = cameras.get("streams")
    if not isinstance(streams, dict) or set(streams) != set(VIEWS):
        raise ValueError("four original camera streams required")
    for view in VIEWS:
        item = streams[view]
        path = root / item.get("path", "")
        if (not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink() or
                item.get("sha256") != sha(path) or
                item.get("frame_count") != 900 or item.get("fps") != 20):
            raise ValueError("source-sealed original camera missing: " + view)
        inspect_video(path, view)
    measured = inspect_original(packet_path)
    measured["physical_completion_probe"] = assess(rows, site)
    measured["camera_manifest_sha256"] = sha(camera_path)
    measured["camera_stream_sha256"] = {view: streams[view]["sha256"] for view in VIEWS}
    measured["legal_hazard_judgment"] = None
    measured["physical_acceptance_claimed"] = False
    return measured


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--case", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(finalize(args.case, args.attempt),
                                      sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n")

                         "traffic_signal_control_active": False,
                         "approach_view_stations": [
                             {"station_id": "far", "distance_to_intersection_m": 12.0, "view_of_through_traffic": True},
                             {"station_id": "near", "distance_to_intersection_m": 3.0, "view_of_through_traffic": True}]},
                "frames": [{"time_s": i * 0.05, "ego_speed_mps": 5.0 - i,

        p = self.packet()
